description: Abstract class defining a cache manager for HTMLPurifier definitions, including methods for generating cache keys, checking cache validity, and managing cache entries.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache
classes.description: Abstract class for managing cache of HTMLPurifier definitions, providing common methods and factory pattern.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specific type of definition objects.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key based on configuration version, batch serial, and revision.

methods.name: isOld
methods.description: Determines if a cache key is outdated compared to current configuration.

methods.name: checkDefType
methods.description: Verifies that a definition's type matches the cache type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Abstract method to unconditionally save a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Abstract method to replace an existing cache entry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a definition object from the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a cache entry.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Abstract method to clear all cache entries.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Abstract method to remove expired cache entries based on version or revision.
